narrative.weekly_mirror: You said yes to the West Amman logo before thinking about when you could do the work, while Sami was not sleeping well and the house felt full. A week later, with Tariq, you chose honesty: "I almost lied but I was too tired to come up with something"—and then told him what was really happening.
narrative.tension_explanation: Your entries hold both the pull of choosing your own path and the weight of family expectations close together. Tariq backed you up when his mother asked whether everything was okay, while your words at dinner left some of your experience unspoken; what that meant for you remains open.
narrative.reflective_question: When you told Tariq the truth but said everything was fine at dinner, what felt different about those two choices?
